title: Aminodiols, aminotetraols and 1,2,3-triazoles based on allo-gibberic acid: stereoselective syntheses and antiproliferative activities
content:
RSC Adv., 2024, 14,36698-36712
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA07334G, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Zein Alabdeen Khdar, Tam Minh Le, Zsuzsanna Schelz, István Zupkó, Zsolt Szakonyi
Various allo-gibberic acid modifications yielded aminodiols, aminotetraols, and triazoles. N-naphthyl aminotetraols and di- or tetrahydroxy triazoles with a diaminopyrimidine moiety showed optimal antiproliferative activity.
